about: Sébastien and Céline LeSeurre arrived on Keuka Lake from France in 2011, bringing six generations of Champagne winemaking on Sébastien’s side and a southwest French vineyard upbringing on Céline’s. After vintages in France, Australia, New Zealand and the US, they chose the Finger Lakes after tasting fruit from vineyards all over the region, and opened their winery on a gentle hill on the lake’s east side in 2013, aiming for wines that sit as well beside fine cuisine as a casual meal.

Cabernet Franc, the red grape of the Loire, has become one of the Finger Lakes’ most convincing reds, ripening reliably in the cool climate. For the Barrel Select bottlings the LeSeurres choose their best lots and give them a long, patient élevage: the winery’s reds spend at least two years in barrel and another year in bottle before release. Sébastien favours mature vines with deep roots and blends fruit from different soils for balance. The 2018 offers strawberry, raspberry and a hint of cola, with gentle red fruit and black pepper on the palate.
facts: At least two years in barrel, one year in bottle
